Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

Opened from the Mail mark in the sidebar strip. It is shown only when the server offers mail and the token is Admin; otherwise the screen reads 'Mail needs an Admin token and the deployed account and message-list routes.' The screen

The search box opens a 'Mail filter' dialog. With one mailbox chosen its placeholder is 'Search this mailbox'. The Folder menu offers Any, Inbox, Outside inbox and Exact label…. The Grouping menu offers Group threads and duplicates,

A row's tag is the account badge: the account label in capitals when it is 4 letters or fewer, otherwise its initials. A thread with several messages shows an 'N in thread' chip, and unread rows have a dot and bold text.

The reader shows ✕ Close message and, when the provider gives a safe link, ↗ Open at provider. The delete command reads 'Delete message' (moves to trash after the confirm 'Delete message?' / 'Move to trash') or 'Delete at provider'
when the server has no delete route.

Below 680px the reader stacks under the list. With no account the screen says 'No mailbox is connected. Add Gmail or Outlook in Settings, under Mail.' Mail account settings (screen_mail.c) are another agent's Settings screen.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
